concerns.text: FR-001 requires a real experimental $T_g$ dataset. Task T003 writes an empty placeholder CSV when the dataset is unavailable, which does not satisfy the functional requirement and weakens it.
FR-003 mandates training an Explainable Boosting Machine. Task T007 makes model training conditional on the presence of $T_g$ data and skips it when absent, effectively narrowing the requirement.
FR-004 requires generation of partial dependence and shape‑function plots. Task T009 is only executed if a model is trained; when $T_g$ data is missing the requirement is silently omitted.

FR-005 mandates validation of feature importance against independent physical properties. Task T010 is conditional on a trained model and is skipped without $T_g$, leaving the functional requirement unfulfilled.
SC-001 demands that the EBM R² exceed a linear‑regression baseline by ≥0.05. No task computes a baseline linear model or records the required comparison, making the success criterion untestable.
SC-004 requires verification that total pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h. Task T013 only sets a GitHub Actions timeout but does not log or output the actual elapsed runtime, so compliance cannot be verified.

Constitution Principle VI specifies validation against WLF constants (C₁, C₂). Tasks T010/T011 validate against Fractional Free Volume and Chain Stiffness instead, constituting a drift from the constitution.
Resource‑guardrail tasks enforce size checks but do not emit measurable artifacts (e.g., logged RAM usage or mode flag) that can be inspected to confirm compliance with the 7 GB RAM limit.
